findings.problem: This 20-line proof lifts a point along the surjective `n`-multiplication map. It is copied token-for-token into at least two other solution files, and each copy re-derives the same instances. The steps are: build the `IsAlgClosed`, `Surjective` and `LocallyOfFiniteType` instances (including `locallyOfFiniteType_of_comp`); lift `z` through `schemeNsmul n` over the algebraically closed residue field; check the structure-map equation `hx'`; then use `nsmul_natural` on `idPoint` to convert the lift into `O.L.nsmul _ n z' = z`. Nothing in the argument depends on the Jacobian or Hecke data, only on a relative group law `L` over `f` with a surjective `schemeNsmul`. Any fix to the argument has to be made in every copy. The CerednikDrinfeld file proves the same fact a third time, with differently derived instances, for the case `𝟙 (Spec k)`.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one general lemma to a shared project file that the solution files import:
`theorem RelativeGroupLaw.exists_nsmul_eq_of_surjective {R : Type} [CommRing R] {X T : Scheme.{0}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)} (L : RelativeGroupLaw R f) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [Surjective (L.schemeNsmul n)] (s : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) [IsAlgClosed K] (hs : s = Spec.map (algebraMap R K)-style point over an alg. closed field) (n : ℕ) (z : SchemeHomOver s f) : ∃ z' : SchemeHomOver s f, L.nsmul s n z' = z`.
The proof is the existing body from lines 241–257. Its statement should be adapted to whichever hypothesis form the `exists_comp_eq_of_surjective_of_locallyOfFiniteType_of_isAlgClosed` lemma needs for the source Spec of an algebraically closed field. After that, this file's version becomes
`exists_nsmul_eq O n hn z := L.exists_nsmul_eq_of_surjective ... (O.nsmul_surjective n hn) ... z`,
with the instances `IsAlgClosed (ResidueField ↥A)` and `LocallyOfFiniteType O.g` supplied at the call site.
The same one-line wrapper replaces the identical proofs in `S_ModularCurve_JZeroNeronObjectAtP_heckeTorsion_ne_bot_of_ptsSp_symm_fibreMap_abqFibre_ne_zero.lean` (line 249) and `S_ModularCurve_JZeroNeronObjectAtP_ptsSp_symm_fibreMap_abqFibre_comp_eq_of_degeneracyHom_heckeGen_self.lean` (line 145).
findings.benefit: The argument is stated and proved once, so a reader of `defect_eq_zero` no longer has to read the instance bookkeeping. A change to `schemeNsmul` or `nsmul_natural` needs one edit instead of three or more, and the CerednikDrinfeld variant can reuse the same lemma.

findings.problem: The fibre-multiplicativity machinery is `mul_castOver`, `overId_eq_castOver`, `toFibrePt_mul`, `ofFibrePt_mul` and `fibreMap_abqFibre_mul`. It shows that `fibreMap (O.abqFibre i)` is a group homomorphism for the relative group laws. It is repeated verbatim in each JZeroNeronObjectAtP solution file that needs it. At least `exists_addMonoidHom_finPts_...`, `exists_abq_family_...`, `ptsSp_symm_..._comp_eq_...` and the `heckeTorsion_ne_bot_...` sibling carry the same five lemmas. The `clsPt_mul` and `Tbar_add` that build on them are also copied. In this file the generic `toFibrePt_mul` and `ofFibrePt_mul` are stated for arbitrary `R`, `R'`, `L`, but they are buried in a `KLift1` namespace and carry `omit` boilerplate. Other files cannot import them, so they are re-proved each time.
